verses.english: “For insight into greed, four things should be developed.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ;
verses.english: Firstly, a mendicant meditates by observing an aspect of the body—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: vedanāsu …pe… citte …pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ.
verses.english: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings … mind … principles—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these four things should be developed.”
